estimates.rationale: Foundational slice: stands up the full persisting stack (models, repository, service, boundary) plus a filing form and index/detail SPA views with the unique (sku, location) constraint.
Reuses FP1's stack but adds an in-place optimistic SPA update (R5, no reload), below-zero rejection (R2), and timestamp/actor tracking (R1) with inline error handling.
New supplier-attributed inbound event with its own form and confirmation flow, incrementing an existing stock row; distinct write path plus supplier reference.
Outbound pick draw-down with write-time overcommit enforcement (R2) and inline shortfall messaging; a distinct guarded write path with a transactional check.
Mostly a read/aggregation slice over data FP1 already persists: a SKU detail view listing multiple location rows, no new write logic.
